output.summary: Turnover rise is real (reconciled to payroll) and larger than peers (47% vs 38% median). Pay is cited at a similar share both years and has not changed in timing, so it does not explain the rise. The monthly step (Mar 2026) coincides with the Saturday policy and the ShiftWise announcement, before go-live. Exit survey shows ShiftWise and other branches in proportion. Manager concentration cannot be judged because PeopleCore manager-of-record is stale. Vacancies drive overtime. Do not give a 15% raise or penalize managers now. Get branch-level separations with corrected manager dates, the pre/post ShiftWise comparison and the pay benchmark. Consider holding the ShiftWise expansion.
